entities.name: Signalled QoS rule
entities.description: A QoS rule provided by the network to the UE associated with a PDU session. Contains components like default QoS rule indication, QoS rule identifier, QoS flow identifier, packet filters, and precedence value.

entities.name: Default QoS rule indication
entities.description: Indicates whether the QoS rule is the default QoS rule for the PDU session. This indication cannot be changed.

entities.name: QoS rule identifier
entities.description: Unique identifier for a signalled QoS rule within a PDU session.

entities.name: QoS flow identifier
entities.description: Identifier for the QoS flow associated with the QoS rule. Multiple QoS rules can be associated with the same QFI.

entities.name: Set of packet filters
entities.description: Optional set of packet filters in a QoS rule, which can include filters for UL, DL, or both directions. For default QoS rules in certain PDU session types, it must not be empty.

entities.name: Precedence value
entities.description: Value indicating the precedence of the QoS rule. For UE-requested QoS rules, the precedence value must not be in the range 70 to 99.

entities.name: Default QoS rule
entities.description: The default QoS rule for a PDU session. In NB-N1 mode, there is only one QoS rule per PDU session, which is the default QoS rule.

entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by SMF to modify PDU session parameters, such as deleting non-default QoS rules when UE moves to NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: NB-N1 mode condition
entities.description: Condition where UE moves into NB-N1 mode, triggering deletion of non-default QoS rules via PDU session modification.

relations.description: A signalled QoS rule contains a default QoS rule indication.
A signalled QoS rule contains a QoS rule identifier.
A signalled QoS rule contains a QoS flow identifier.
A signalled QoS rule optionally contains a set of packet filters.

The default QoS rule requires that the set of packet filters is not empty.
